text_translation: Are you ignorant that the custom has been for word to be written first to us, and then for a just decision to be passed from this place?
locus: Julius, Letter to the Eusebian Bishops, in Athanasius, Apologia contra Arianos 21 (part of the letter spanning ch. 20-35; the edition's own table of contents dates the letter 340 CE, one year off srcIJC04's 341 - not silently harmonized here)
